## The Temperature Probe  
Temperature Probe Datasheet: [https://github.com/CalPoly-UROV/Embedded24-25/blob/main/Docs/DS18B20.pdf](https://github.com/CalPoly-UROV/Embedded24-25/blob/main/Docs/DS18B20.pdf)

#### Page 1:
- Uses 3 wires: high, low, and communication
	- unique because most sensors usually use at least 2 wires for communication
- Allows for multiple sensors to be connected to a single microcontroller
	- This is common for sensors to be able to be chained like this
	- Each sensor has a unique rom code/ID which allows for the microcontroller to differentiate and select a specific sensor

#### Page 10: Transaction Sequence
- This tells us what steps to take to talk will the sensor. Most of our firmware coding revolves around finding out how to talk with a sensor
- Steps: Initialization, ROM Command, ROM Command Data Transfer, Sensor Command, Sensor Command Data Transfer

#### Open Drain Wire Protocol
- Explain how the open drain and push/pull functionality works for communication
- How to set up open drain config on IOC
#### Code
Goal: Write a function `TempProbe_presence()` This function sends a reset pulse, detects if the probe is connected, and prints the result to the console.

Use the blocking delay function. This makes developing the commands later much easier. You can try implementing fully interrupt-based logic on your own time.

## Task 3: Writing to Probe

![A diagram of a bus](data:image/png;base64,)

To send commands and read data from the probe, the communication protocol calls for us to issue these read and write slots. We will begin with write slots

Goal: Write 2 functions: `write_bit(uint8_t bit)` and `write_byte(uint8_t byte)`

#### `write_bit(bit)`
This function takes in an argument 1 or 0. It issues the corresponding write slot

#### `write_byte(byte)`
This function takes in an argument byte. It calls `write_bit()` 8 times and writes out the full byte

## Task 4: Reading from Probe
Goal: Write 2 functions: `read_bit()` and `read_byte()`

#### `read_bit()`
This function issues a read slot and returns whether it read a 0 or 1.  
```
Pull Pin Low
Release Pin High
delay 15us
Read pin
```
#### read_byte()
This function calls read_bit() 8 times and returns the full byte
